title: Publish the genomic-only store as refgetstore/genomic-2026-10-27.tar.gz

commands.label: create-archive
argv: set -euo pipefail; tar --no-mac-metadata --no-xattrs --no-acls --uid 0 --gid 0 --uname root --gname root -C /Volumes/RefgetStores -cf - genomic-2026-10-27 | pigz -6 > /Volumes/RefgetStores/archive.wK1v/genomic-2026-10-27.tar.gz; cd /Volumes/RefgetStores/archive.wK1v; shasum -a 256 genomic-2026-10-27.tar.gz | tee genomic-2026-10-27.tar.gz.sha256; ls -l genomic-2026-10-27.tar.gz

commands.label: create-archive-mode-755
argv: set -euo pipefail; tar --no-mac-metadata --no-xattrs --no-acls --uid 0 --gid 0 --uname root --gname root -C /Volumes/RefgetStores -cf - genomic-2026-10-27 | pigz -6 > /Volumes/RefgetStores/archive.wK1v/genomic-2026-10-27.tar.gz; cd /Volumes/RefgetStores/archive.wK1v; shasum -a 256 genomic-2026-10-27.tar.gz | tee genomic-2026-10-27.tar.gz.sha256; ls -l genomic-2026-10-27.tar.gz; tar -tzvf genomic-2026-10-27.tar.gz | head -1

commands.label: upload
argv: set -euo pipefail; for f in genomic-2026-10-27.tar.gz genomic-2026-10-27.tar.gz.sha256; do rclone copyto /Volumes/RefgetStores/archive.wK1v/$f theferrit32-public:theferrit32-public/refgetstore/$f --s3-no-check-bucket --stats-one-line --stats 30s; done; rclone check /Volumes/RefgetStores/archive.wK1v theferrit32-public:theferrit32-public/refgetstore/ --include 'genomic-2026-10-27.tar.gz*' --s3-no-check-bucket

result_summary.superseded_attempt: create-archive produced an archive whose top-level directory was mode 0700 (the store directory was made with mktemp); create-archive-mode-755 rebuilt it after chmod 755, and only that archive was uploaded

validations.name: extract-and-diff
validations.detail: the uploaded archive extracts to a tree identical to the store directory (diff -rq), 13,682 files, no AppleDouble entries, root:root ownership

validations.name: public-url
validations.detail: HTTP 200 with the full content length; the .sha256 serves the archive's digest; clinvar-ingest vrsify downloaded, verified and extracted it and produced output identical to a run on the local store
